Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: exact historical softly painted Silent Storm eye COLOR UV layer.

Input image1 is the exact whole64x64 source RGBA. Image2 is the IDENTICAL whole storedRGB nearest12x source-only guide. Faithfully refine this same complete bitmap at higher resolution, with only very subtle finer original paint. Keep exactly the reference full square composition, every original location, pupil/iris proportions, all soft gray-brown filler and the gentle broad light/dark washes, native pattern scale and original tinted palette. No face, eyelids or new anatomy. This is a softly painted game texture, not a realistic photograph.

Keep ONE original iris centered near33,30 and ONE original dark central pupil at exactly the original footprint. Preserve TWO already existing softly painted reflection patches only: upper weak vertical patch near native[31,21,35,27) with source peak33,24 RGB[168, 162, 162]; lower SMALL DIM TINTED patch near[29,35,34,39), peak31,36 RGB[141, 135, 131]. The lower patch is weaker and tinted as in source, never a white glossy catchlight. Preserve their exact native center/size/color relationship/softness. Do not create any third light spot, white glint, specular ring or new radial iris design.

Keep the iris original softly mottled subdued pigment distribution and soft dark border, not sharp crystalline jewel/mosaic/stripes. No photofibers, etched radial fibers, spokes, capillaries/veins, checker/mosaic/noise/weave, harsh glossy bevel, enlarged highlights, new iris rings, invented pores or glossy wet geometry. Do not sharpen the existing pale patches into white photoglare. Do not change shadow/fill colors or brighten black native pigment; retain the source local hierarchy and original gray-brown sclera softness.

Output the ENTIRE square source canvas edge to edge with EXACT same normalized UV. Full original sourceA255 will be restored independently and brightness corrected with one pure scalar; avoid local highlight strengthening. No crop, zoom, padding, whitespace, fitting individual iris, BBox registration, isolated eye cutout or UV rearrangement. No text/logos/new markings. Actual dynamic eye color layer remains unchanged.
